rationale: Touch device users cannot see or interact with the wishlist button since :hover doesn't trigger on tap. This breaks a key e-commerce feature for a significant user segment.
problemSolved: In _product-card.css (lines 94-111), .product-card-wishlistBtn has opacity: 0 by default and only becomes visible on .product-card:hover (lines 114-117). On touch devices, this button never appears.
